summary: Gladstone Investment Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit facility. On June 10, 2026, the company through its subsidiary amended its Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with KeyBank and other lenders. The amendment extends the revolving period to June 8, 2029, and final maturity to two years after that, reduces interest rate to 30-day SOFR + 2.85-3.35% based on period, and increases facility size from $300M to $405M with ability to increase to $500M. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms disclosed.
